sources.notes: RoboWorld uses neural simulator, policy evaluation, Step Forcing, task-progress-aware scoring, and sim-real rank alignment.
Qwen-RobotWorld groups current applications into synthetic data generation, virtual policy evaluation, and language-guided planning signals.
MotuBrain uses the current term world action model for joint video-action prediction and real-time control.
Persistent Robot World Models foregrounds autoregressive rollout drift and rollout-stabilizing post-training.

terms.why: Names the most directly validated offline application surface.
Separates generating a rollout from scoring policy progress.
Captures joint prediction-and-control systems that may not use video world model in metadata.
Captures long-horizon stabilization and compounding-error work.
